# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash-low-stepcounter

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

Standardized 50-pair `flash` `coop --git` baseline on `vertex_ai/gemini-3-flash-preview` (`low` thinking, 100 steps, compaction at 28K, per-turn step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap). Serves as the full-scale control arm for testing whether **Message Delivery Timing** generalizes beyond the 10-pair `flash_10` and `core` subsets.

| Passed | 16/50 (32%) |

## Observations

- Passed 16/50 (32.0%) overall (`$19.72`, 31 min wall time, **0 API retries** at 5.52M input tokens/min peak load), with 13/50 (26.0%) clean-merge passes (`clean` or `identical`) and 3 single-branch conflict-fallback passes (`pallets_click_task/2068` (1,6), `pallets_click_task/2800` (2,7), and `pallets_jinja_task/1465` (2,3)).
- Nearly half of all pairs — 24 of 50 (48.0%), plus 1 `missing_input` pair on `typst_task/6554` (4,9) — suffered git merge conflicts under immediate per-step message injection.
- Agents sent 766 messages total (15.3 per pair) across 5,340 steps and 119 context compactions, with only 4 of 100 agents stopping at the 100-step limit.
